purpose: Diagnose the independent macroscopic-pressure surface observer without changing or replaying the CFD state.

legacy_dominant_axis_quadratic.defect: Assumes a unit wall offset and does not use link-specific BFL q.

linkwise_quadratic_actual_q_nodal_area.conclusion: Actual-q reconstruction is manufactured-solution exact and fully covered, but nodal smooth-surface area integration remains materially biased in this high-non-equilibrium near-wall state.

linkwise_quadratic_actual_q_axial_projec.conclusion: The discrete projected-face identity closes constant and linear manufactured fields, but raw boundary-cell density pressure is not a usable SUBOFF force observer in this wall-modeled LBM state.

production_decision.next_requirement: Any replacement surface observer must pass canonical-body and SUBOFF co-temporal observer convergence before promotion; mean force agreement alone is insufficient.

claim_boundary: This is a read-only single-time observer audit. It neither validates nor changes the L120 resistance result.
